user.title: Spatial Context
user.description: Trace each floor's layout and place your devices on it, so an AI assistant can be given real physical context for your home.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Spatial Context is already set up.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Returns the full spatial context map, including floors, rooms, walls, and devices.

refresh_zigbee_mesh.name: Refresh Zigbee mesh
refresh_zigbee_mesh.description: Forces a fresh Zigbee2MQTT network scan and caches the result, so the panel's own "Load Mesh" can serve it instantly. Intended for a scheduled/overnight automation, not interactive use (a scan can take 1-2 minutes).
